title: 第21章 异父异母的亲哥哥第22章 专业的清场方式
slug: 转生反派贵族妈妈们都太爱我了
content_zh:
;;
废弃修道院的空气里总是有股霉味，混合着陈旧的香烛气息，像极了把一堆烂木头塞进棺材里发酵了几百年的味道。
肖恩把背后的门板顶死，又拖来两张缺腿的长椅卡在门把手上。
做完这一切，他才靠着墙滑坐在地。
外面的风声不对劲。
那不是自然风刮过废墟的呼啸，而是无数骨头架子摩擦地面的细碎声响，密集得让人头皮发麻。
亡灵军团的搜捕网正在收紧。
“暂时安全了。”
肖恩抹了一把脸上的灰，扭头看向缩在祭坛阴影里的两人。
伊莎贝拉正抱着莱拉。
那女孩脏得像个泥猴，只有那双黑白分明的眼睛还是亮的，正死死盯着肖恩。
那眼神很有意思。
不像是在看救命恩人，倒像是在看一个入室抢劫的土匪。
特别是当肖恩的视线无意间扫过伊莎贝拉胸口时，莱拉的眉头就皱得更紧了，两只小手护食似的抓着他妈的衣领。
这女娃。
“妈妈，饿。”
莱拉的声音很小也很沙哑。
伊莎贝拉身子一僵。
她有些慌乱地看了一眼肖恩，苍白的脸上浮起一层尴尬的红晕。
但怀里的女孩在发抖。

伊莎贝拉咬着下唇，不再犹豫。
她背过身去，解开了胸前的纽扣。
布料摩擦的声音在死寂的教堂里格外清晰。
她还嫌弃的擦了擦。
没过几秒，那边传来了吞咽声。
很急，很响，像是一头没断奶的小兽终于找到了水源。
肖恩靠在墙上，喉结上下滚了一下。
他从口袋里摸出一块干硬的黑面包，那是从死掉的邪教徒身上搜来的。
咬了一口，满嘴木渣子味，更是让他怀念起那股甘甜的暖流。
几分钟后，吞咽声停了。
伊莎贝拉整理好衣服转过身。
莱拉趴在她怀里，小脸上多了几分血色。
这女娃也是个人才，吃饱喝足后，还得寸进尺地抬起袖子，擦了擦嘴边溢出的一点奶渍，然后示威般地冲肖恩扬了扬下巴。
那表情分明在说：这是我的，没你的份。
肖恩被气笑了。
行，以后等你长大成了黑暗之女，老子第一个把你吊路灯上。
……
时间在煎熬中流逝。
外面的天色黑了又亮，亮了又黑。
整整一天，亡灵军团不仅没有撤退，反而像嗅到了血腥味的鲨鱼，把包围圈缩得更小了。

图鉴空间里并没有储备食物。
肖恩是个战士，出门带斧头带药水，唯独没想过带干粮。
那块硬得能砸死人的黑面包早就吃完了。
肖恩感觉自己的胃壁正在相互摩擦，发出酸涩的抗议。
这种物理层面上的饥饿还会导致精神上的烦躁，特别是那股若有若无的奶香味一直往鼻子里钻，简直是在考验他的意志力。

There is always a musty smell in the air of the abandoned monastery, mixed with the smell of old incense candles, like the smell of a pile of rotten wood stuffed into a coffin and fermented for hundreds of years.
Sean pushed the door panel behind him shut, then dragged two benches with missing legs and stuck them on the door handles.
After doing all this, he slid against the wall and sat on the ground.
Something is wrong with the wind outside.
It was not the roar of the natural wind blowing across the ruins, but the sound of countless bones rubbing against the ground, so dense that it made one's scalp numb.
The manhunt for the undead army is tightening.
"It's safe for now."
Sean wiped the ashes from his face and turned to look at the two people huddled in the shadow of the altar.
Isabella is holding Lila.
The girl was as dirty as a mud monkey, but her black and white eyes were still bright, staring at Sean.
That look was interesting.
It's not like I'm looking at my savior, but like I'm looking at a bandit who's breaking into a house.
Especially when Sean's eyes glanced at Isabella's chest unintentionally, Laila's brows furrowed even more tightly, and her two little hands grabbed her fucking collar like a protective weapon.
This girl.
"Mom, I'm hungry."
Laila's voice was small and husky.
Isabella stiffened.
She glanced at Sean in a panic, a blush of embarrassment appearing on her pale face.
But the girl in her arms was shaking.
Isabella bit her lower lip and hesitated no longer.
She turned away and unbuttoned her chest.
The sound of cloth rubbing was particularly clear in the dead silence of the church.
She even wiped it in disgust.
Within a few seconds, there was a swallowing sound from over there.
It was very urgent and loud, like a little unweaned animal that had finally found the water source.
Sean leaned against the wall, his Adam's apple rolling up and down.
He took out a piece of dry, hard black bread from his pocket, which he had collected from the dead cultist.
After taking a bite, his mouth was filled with the smell of wood residue, which made him miss the sweet warmth even more.
After a few minutes, the swallowing stopped.
Isabella straightened her clothes and turned around.
Laila lay in her arms, her little face became a little brighter.
This girl is also a talent. After eating and drinking, she would raise her sleeves to the extreme, wipe the milk stains that spilled from her mouth, and then raise her chin at Sean in a demonstrative manner.
That expression clearly said: This is mine, not yours.
Sean laughed angrily.
Okay, when you grow up and become the daughter of darkness, I will be the first to hang you from the street lamp.
…
Time passes in agony.
The sky outside is dark and bright, bright and dark again.
For a whole day, not only did the undead army not retreat, but like sharks that smelled blood, they narrowed the encirclement even smaller.
There is no food stored in the illustrated space.
Sean is a warrior. He carries an ax and potions when he goes out, but he never thought of bringing dry food.
The piece of black bread that was so hard that it could kill someone has long been eaten.
Sean felt his stomach walls rubbing against each other, making a sour protest.
This kind of physical hunger can also lead to mental irritability, especially the faint smell of milk that keeps entering his nose, which is simply a test of his willpower.
